text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, aah~~ What an auspicious day today 
is~♪

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha!! Splendid that you have greeted 
this momentous day! Allow me to perform a 
melody of blessing for you!!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
U-Urara-chan, that might sound more like 
Opera O-san rather than an opera style...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu... That's it, keep going just like 
that!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Happy birthday to you~♪ Ope-cha~n!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Mm! Splendid! That melody was truly worthy 
of gracing the day of my birth!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
B-But... Rice couldn't celebrate with you 
as well as Urara-chan did...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Huh, not at all! It was super fun! Right, 
Opera-chan?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! Mishaps are part of the fun! A 
miraculous, one-of-a-kind stage created by 
you as the performers, and me as the 
audience!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I deeply appreciate you witnessing this 
historic moment. Fufufu... Haaahahahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, Ope-chan looks so happy! I'm glad 
it all worked out! Hwah-hah-hah-hah!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, thank you, Urara-chan... 
Congratulations, Opera O-san.
